properties.name: camel.mcp-server.enabled
properties.description: Whether to expose ai-tool routes as MCP tools through the Spring AI MCP server. Enabled by default when the starter is on the classpath.

properties.name: camel.mcp-server.tags
properties.description: Comma-separated list of ai-tool tags to expose as MCP tools. Only tools registered under one of these tags are exposed; the untagged default pool is never exposed. When not set, no tools are exposed.

properties.name: camel.mcp-server.tool-timeout
properties.description: Per-call tool execution timeout in milliseconds. A call exceeding the timeout returns an error result to the MCP client; the underlying route keeps running until it completes on its own.
